about: T-431 P3 (2026-10-21): the daemon-emoji over the follower. A on it draws a small screen with a tail whose face is built from the lead's feelings, none of them named: EYES from CALM (half-lidded at +20 or more, wide at -20 or less, open between), MOUTH from GLAD - SAD (up at +20, down at -20, flat between), TINT from MAD (none under 20, warm from 20, hot from 40) -- the SUMMARY page's own lines (FEELINGS_LEAN, FEELINGS_QUIET, FEELINGS_MAD_LINE). Its own OBJ palette while it shows, greyed by friendship as the follower is, kept in colour in HALFTONE; a hidden item still gets the trainers' !!, and with no palette slot free the friendship bubble of T-18 P2 shows instead. A never-stamped daemon is open, flat, cool. Values written outright with `feel` (stamped now), or pushed by DEBUG -> GAME EVENTS -> FEELINGS's PUSH rows. Debug scratch save.
